hero_kpi_rationale: Operating income is a master KPI for the sensors and electronic components industry, demonstrating operational efficiency and the ability to convert revenue into profit despite market cycles.

kpis.name: Net leverage ratio
kpis.explanation: Net leverage ratio (Gross debt - Cash) / Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.signal: Decline in net leverage ratio in 2025

kpis.name: Organic revenue growth
kpis.explanation: Revenue growth excluding foreign exchange effects and acquisitions/disposals

kpis.name: Consolidated operating income
kpis.explanation: Net revenue minus operating costs, excluding interest and taxes
kpis.signal: Significant increase in operating income in 2025

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Decline in demand
risks.score_rationale: A decline in demand in key markets, particularly the automotive industry which represents 57% of revenue, could have a material negative impact on the company's results.

risks.title: Product risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to product liability, warranty, and recall risks, which could negatively impact the company's results.

risks.title: Component shortages
risks.score_rationale: Shortages of components and raw materials could increase production costs and reduce manufacturing capacity, negatively impacting the company's results.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in highly competitive markets, which could require price reductions or lead to decreased demand for its products.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks, which could negatively impact operations and the company's reputation.

risks.title: Restructuring
risks.score_rationale: Business reorganization or divestiture of certain activities could negatively impact the company's results and cost structure.

risks.title: Labor costs
risks.score_rationale: Increases in labor costs and production disruptions could negatively impact the company's results.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory changes, particularly regarding vehicle safety and emissions, could affect the company's growth opportunities.
